_note: SGP30 multi-pixel gas sensor module (Sensirion). I2C interface, fixed address 0x58. 4-pin breakout: VCC, GND, SDA, SCL. Measures eCO2 (400-60000 ppm) and TVOC (0-60000 ppb). On-chip humidity compensation. 15-second warm-up, 1 Hz measurement rate. Adafruit-style breakout with onboard regulator and level shifting.
